name: ux2-u25-polish
prompt:
In public/css/ux2.css (STU-UX2) fix three things seen on the screenshots; add or change only these rules:
1. The play button holds two icons (svg paths .i-play and .i-pause); while paused both show on top of each other. Add `.wave-play .i-pause { display: none; }` before the existing `.wave-player.playing ...` rules (those keep switching them while playing).
2. The waveform is squeezed: the .wave-player sits in the card's `.job-actions` flex row. Add `.job-actions .wave-player { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }` so it takes the free width next to the two download links.
3. The keyboard map dialog sits in the top-left corner because style.css resets every margin to 0 (`* { margin: 0 }`), which removes a dialog's centring. Add `margin: auto;` to the `.keymap` rule.
